description:
High-voltage electric transmission lines (100 kV and above) near a US street address, from federal infrastructure
        data: every mapped line within 1 mile, nearest first, with distance in feet and miles, direction, voltage,
        owner as recorded, the two substations it connects and its status, plus counts within 500 ft, 1/4, 1/2 and 1
        mile. Local distribution lines on street poles are NOT in the data. Returns the tool page URL.
name: power_lines_near_address
